messages:
evan: Quick RFC follow-up idea: introduce a regional "edge quota gateway" to absorb short-lived admission chatter so the central bank stays focused on durable leases.

anjali: sounds useful. what's the canonical contract between edge->gateway->bank?

evan: keep it tiny: gateway.Check(req) -> {decision, lease_id?, ttl_ms, score}. bank also streams policy deltas to gateway. use gRPC + mTLS.

mike: gateway should only serve soft-allow for very short TTLs (<=5s). all fairness and long-term reservations remain authoritative at the bank.

sara: failure semantics? if gateway loses contact with bank do we fail open?

evan: fail-soft: gateway honors cached soft-allow for graceTTL (configurable), then returns 429. edge proxies can fallback to direct bank with stricter limits.

lucas: abuse signals: gateway must subscribe to recent deltas and instantly invalidate cache for flagged tenants. every local deny must emit an auditable event.

anjali: ops: plan for 3 replicas/region, sticky hashing by edge-cluster, metric-driven circuit state (normal/backoff/degraded). add per-tenant hit/miss metrics.

mike: rollout: passive proxy -> soft-allow for internal tenants -> expand. include header X-Quota-Gateway-Version for compatibility.

sara: will add debug endpoint to trace decisions and a HMAC signature header so bank can validate gateway admits.

evan: sim numbers looked promising: 20-35% bank QPS reduction for bursty flows with a 2-5s soft TTL.

quota-bot: action created: INFRA-1300 "edge-quota-gateway: proto + PoC" assigned to lucas, sara, anjali due 2w.

mike: if no objections I'll move this to RFC follow-up board and tag eng-sre for the HA runbook.

lucas: ack, will start proto draft today.

anjali: thanks, will sync on PoC results next week.
